name: Safuwallet
rootCause: ZenGo co-founder Ouriel Ohayon reported on Twitter that the wallet extension SAFU Wallet apparently steals large amounts of money by injecting malicious code into users. A white hat hacker said that by inspecting the SAFU code, he found that they dynamically injected this script https://safuwallet.tk/inside.js in every page being loaded. At the same time, they use obfuscation tools to make it hard to see. Nonetheless, the white hat hackers explained that they targeted MEW, Index and Binance, using background scripts to send information to 4 different endpoints on the same domain. Therefore, the created wallet is automatically shared with them. Currentl…
